# SOMevidence 1.1.3 local validation

Validation date: 2026-08-11 (Asia/Shanghai)

This record covers the release-candidate source before public tagging. It
separates scientific-output equivalence, package checks and descriptive local
performance measurements. Remote build identity is verified after release.

## Compatibility and scientific-output checks

- All 1,548 test expectations passed with optional Shiny, GMM and future
  dependencies installed.
- Exported functions, arguments, defaults and the version 1.1 object contract
  remain unchanged.
- Fourteen complete analysis objects regenerated by version 1.1.3 were
  identical to objects generated from the immutable version 1.1.2 source tag.
  The oracle file had SHA-256
  `2914fda1edfdb7fb65d372c0c3c1371a08ba2aa6d612e206b0c46d0edb41bfe2`.
- Differential randomized checks independently compared 2,000 ARI/AMI cases,
  400 topographic-error cases, 1,000 complete co-assignment cases and 500
  incremental-alignment cases with the version 1.1.2 kernels; all matched.
- The release tests explicitly retain record ordering, warning and failure
  repetition, `fail_fast` execution order, random-number state, complete and
  missing-label paths, and sequential/future equivalence.
- Two independent read-only implementation reviews reported PASS after one
  detected eager Ward-tree execution was corrected and re-reviewed.

## Package and documentation checks

- Test coverage: 93.52%.
- `lintr` reported no findings in package code, regression tests or release
  scripts.
- Roxygen documentation regeneration was idempotent.
- Citation metadata parsed successfully and matched package version 1.1.3,
  the sole author and the maintainer email.
- The complete pkgdown site, including all five articles, built successfully
  from an installed candidate package.
- The PDF reference manual built successfully as a non-empty 27-page file.
- `R CMD check --as-cran --no-manual` completed on macOS and R 4.5.3 with
  `Status: OK`.

## Source-archive review

- Candidate archive: `SOMevidence_1.1.3.tar.gz`.
- SHA-256: `dd20543435d185ec362480fc0ab8fff972c5c892ee8fae08ea890067b09daeb6`.
- Gzip integrity, archive listing, extraction and package metadata checks
  passed.
- The archive contained no local absolute paths, credentials, repository
  metadata, temporary files, unpublished coordinates or unapproved author and
  contributor names.
- Package authorship remained limited to Shaowen Ye, with maintainer email
  `yeshaowen2119@gmail.com`. AI-assisted development remained a provenance
  disclosure, not authorship or contributorship.

## Performance evidence

The separately reproducible local benchmark required identical outputs before
timing. It recorded a substantial reduction in ensemble task metadata and
directional improvements in analysis-row distances, complete co-assignment,
alignment propagation and Ward.D2 reuse. These measurements are descriptive;
they are not CI thresholds or cross-platform guarantees.

## Remote release gate

This local record does not by itself constitute a release. The exact public
candidate must still pass the GitHub Actions check matrix, PDF-manual job,
coverage, lint, pkgdown build and remote CRAN incoming preflight before an
annotated stable release tag is created. GitHub Pages and R-universe source
identity are then verified against that tag.
